def transform_candidate(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    markers = [(r, row[0]) for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0]
    n = len(markers)
    pattern = [None] * n
    for r, color in markers:
        pattern[r % n] = color
    return [[pattern[r % n] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

demo1 = [[0]*27 for _ in range(27)]
for r,c in [(6,4),(7,8),(9,6),(14,3),(22,6),(23,5)]: demo1[r]=[c]*27
out1 = transform_candidate(demo1)
expected_sequence = [4,8,3,6,6,5]
print('demo pattern:', [row[0] for row in out1[:6]], 'valid:', [row[0] for row in out1] == [expected_sequence[i%6] for i in range(27)])

program = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    markers = [(r, row[0]) for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0]
    period = len(markers)
    pattern = [0] * period
    for r, color in markers:
        pattern[r % period] = color
    return [[pattern[r % period] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
